chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad from al-Hasan ibn Mahbub from Ali ibn Ribat from Ibn Muskhan from al-Halabi from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him)
Regarding the maternal siblings with the grandfather, he said: 'For the maternal siblings with the grandfather, their share is one-third with the grandfather.'
ai.seo_question: What is the inheritance share of maternal siblings when inheriting with the paternal grandfather?
ai.summary: This narration from Al-Tusi's *Tahdhib* clarifies the specific ruling for maternal siblings inheriting concurrently with the paternal grandfather, assigning them a fixed one-third share. This ruling is significant in Shia jurisprudence as it distinguishes the grandfather's role as a residual heir (or co-heir depending on the school of thought regarding his exclusion of other ancestors) while ensuring maternal siblings receive their Quranic portion without being fully excluded by the grandfather's presence.
